title: Word Movement (w, b, e)
instruction_text:
Navigate by words, not just characters!

'w' = jump to start of next word
'b' = jump back to start of previous word
'e' = jump to end of word

Your task: Delete the word 'fast' from the sentence.

Steps:
1. Press 'w' multiple times to jump to 'fast'
2. When cursor is on 'f' of 'fast', press 'dw'
   (dw = delete word)
3. Save and quit with :wq

Much faster than using 'l' repeatedly!
setup_file: The quick brown fast fox jumps over the lazy dog
target_content: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
